inspection.scope: Full bulk Lagrangian and explicit five-dimensional orbifold specialization, separate from generic dimensional family.
inspection.coverage_note: These are passages and model-definition sections actually inspected, not a claim that every sentence on each page or the entire PDF was read. Field claims are retained separately in field-evidence.json; legacy records remain unchecked reference material.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

locator.section_equations: Section2 Eq.(2.1) and adjacent dimensional/fermion definitions

claims.value: Bulk gauge algebra is GSM; Q,U,D,L,E are bulk fermions with three generations (Yukawas3x3) and one bulk complex Higgs doublet. Odd-dimensional fermions are vector-like bulk spinors, NOT 4D Weyl fields. Source zero modes U,D,E are RH, but five-dimensional bulk representations retain source colour3,Y=2/3,-1/3,-1; no blind 4D conjugation.

Source explicitly defines delta=1 on S1/Z2. Encode Lorentz B2 [0,1] for each bulk spinor and [0,0] for scalar. KK levels/gauge fifth components are modes of bulk fields, not extra elementary inventory copies. Generic delta family remains distinct; even-dimensional singlet anomaly completions not fixed.

source_descriptions.reason: Generic delta requires a dimension-specific Lorentz and anomaly-completion choice. Ready candidate covers only explicitly defined five-dimensional specialization.
